asked.item: Is TikTok analytics broken on my account / Claude can't filter TikTok
Can it rank my LinkedIn posts

verdict.reason: The pages explain that the MCP top-posts tool covers fewer platforms than the web app and REST API, and that LinkedIn analytics are not available.

steps.text: The blotatolisttopposts MCP tool currently ranks posts from Twitter/X, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, and Bluesky.
The MCP filter list is narrower than the backend's collection coverage, so TikTok not being in Claude's filter reflects that.
Use the REST API for top-post rankings on TikTok, YouTube, or Pinterest.
The Blotato web app also covers TikTok, and its Top posts section has a ranking selector.
LinkedIn and Slack analytics are not available, so LinkedIn posts can't be ranked.
